summary: Iterates a set of cloud scene objects, partitions candidates into two groups by matching their 6-character name against the aClouds and aCloudr patterns, then randomly selects one object from each group via the LCG and copies 31 bytes from it into an output slot (this+80 and this+132). Clears per-slot flags at this 0x6F and 0xA3 after each copy.

operations.description: Reads the object count at a2+280; if it is not greater than 0 the whole partition-and-select pass is skipped.
Iterates count times, advancing the object pointer by 256 bytes per entry (a2+296 base) and collecting candidate object pointers into two lists.
Compares the candidate name at v5+20 against the aClouds 6-char pattern via sub_588640; a non-match makes the object eligible for the first (aClouds) group.
Stores the candidate pointer into first-group list slot v12[v4] and increments v4, bounded by the v4 < 256 guard.
Compares the candidate name at v5+20 against the aCloudr 6-char pattern via sub_588640; a non-match makes the object eligible for the second (aCloudr) group.
Stores the candidate pointer into second-group list slot v12[v9 + 256] and increments v9, bounded by the v9 < 256 guard.
If first-group list is empty (v4 <= 0), the first random selection is skipped.
Calls the LCG random number generator to pick the first-group selection.
Binds the LCG result to the list size via modulo v4 to select an index into the first-group list.
Copies 31 bytes from the selected first-group object (selected + 20) into the output slot at this+80 via sub_587DD0.
Clears the this 0x6F flag/state byte for the first selected cloud after the copy.
If second-group list is empty (v9 <= 0), the second random selection is skipped.
Calls the LCG random number generator and reduces the result by modulo v9 to select an index into the second-group list.
Copies 31 bytes from the selected second-group object (selected + 20) into the output slot at this+132 via sub_587DD0.
Clears the this 0xA3 flag/state byte for the second selected cloud after the copy.
Returns the result of the last sub_587DD0 copy (or the initial count read when the pass was skipped).

unresolved: LCG is invoked with an uninitialized-looking argument register; its exact signature is unproven.
The identity of the a2 container (object list owner) and of the this object is unknown.
Byte strides 256 and +20 access points inside child objects whose layout is not established.
Semantics of the this 0x6F / 0xA3 flags beyond 'reset after selection' are unknown.
